newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end near week's high as Dow, gilts gain.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end near week's high as Dow, gilts gain.

text.p: UK shares shook off their interest rate worries on Friday to close near the week's highest levels, taking their lead from sharply higher gilts and the latest record-breaking advance on Wall Street.

The FTSE 100 index closed 32.1 points higher at 3,958.2, leaving it up 47.4 points on the week. Gainers outweighed losers by three-to-one, with Railtrack surging on better-than-expected results and GUS extending gains on Thursday's U.S. acquisition.
Traders and fund managers said shares could rise further given support from Wall Street and bonds, though fears of rising interest rates could revive ahead of the Budget on November 26.
